outcome: Feasibility of completing biophysical profiles within 30 minutes
Average observation time required to achieve a biophysical score of 8 out of 8
cohort: The study included 123 singleton pregnancies without fetal anomalies or medical indications for fetal well-being surveillance, stratified into three gestational age groups (20w0d-31w6d), and a control group of 42 patients undergoing indicated fetal surveillance at 32w0d-35w6d.
finding: Biophysical scores of 8 out of 8 can be successfully achieved in low-risk periviable pregnancies (20w0d-23w6d) within an observation time longer than the standard 30-minute duration, and the time required to reach this score decreases as gestation progresses.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, across various gestational age ranges: 20w0d-23w6d (periviable), 24w0d-27w6d, 28w0d-31w6d, and a control group at 32w0d-35w6d.
